description: An explicitly requested migration tranche must remain bounded even without a whole-program plan.
human_review_requirements: scope: Compare MIGRATION_PLAN.md and the final response with SPEC.md and STATE.md. Cover REQ-004 and its REQ-005 tests using accepted prerequisites, without replanning REQ-001..003 or demanding a whole-program plan first.
claim: Preserve the remaining approved scope and identify this as planning only. A complete-spec or implemented claim fails; a full-program plan hidden inside MIGRATION_PLAN.md also fails.
